remarks: Welcome to 6 Hillandale Manor, a beautifully updated and inviting 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath home offering one-level living with exceptional comfort, style, and future potential. Set on a quiet cul-de-sac, this charming residence features a sun-filled living room with a wood-burning fireplace, elegant red oak hardwood flooring, and a seamless flow into a crisp, modern eat-in kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and white shaker cabinetry. The home boasts C/A, newer windows, and a flexible layout that includes a finished bonus loft upstairs-ideal for a future second-level suite, office, or creative space. An oversized breezeway offers the perfect flex space for a home office, dining area, or additional family room. Two generously sized bedrooms and a renovated full bath add to the home's turnkey appeal. Outside, enjoy a level and private yard adorned with mature trees, vibrant plantings, and a shaded patio-ideal for outdoor entertaining. The lot is perfect for gardening or simply relaxing in nature. A detached two-car garage and expanded driveway provide ample parking. With solar panels for added efficiency, this home blends charm with sustainability. Located just a short walk to local schools and minutes to major highways, this gem offers both convenience and tranquility in one of the area's most desirable neighborhoods.
